create.name: Gena Davis
create.bio:
Gena Davis is an Episcopal priest, spiritual director and teacher of yoga and meditation who lives in the greater Houston area of Texas. Before ordination she spent some twenty years working in human resources technology. She began training as a spiritual director in 2002, became an oblate of the World Community for Christian Meditation and completed her divinity degree at the Episcopal seminary in Austin, and was ordained priest in 2010, serving a small Houston congregation until 2017. Her yoga studies include teacher training at Nosara in Costa Rica, further training in the Pralaya system and advanced work in Amrit Yoga Nidra.

In 2016 she began YogaMass, a form of Christian worship that brings breath, movement and meditation into the Eucharist, and she has since written a book about it as well as a deck of yoga prayer cards. She also plays alchemy crystal singing bowls, teaches others to use them, and in 2020 co-founded a crystal bowl gallery with a friend. Her private sessions, in person in Fulshear or over Zoom, draw on spiritual direction, guided meditation, energy work and sound, and she leads yoga nidra evenings and sound baths for groups around Houston. Recordings of her meditations can be found on her website, podcast and YouTube channel.

courses.title: Private sessions with Gena Davis
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in person in Fulshear, Texas, or over Zoom, shaped around spiritual direction, guided meditation, breath and yoga, energy work and crystal bowl sound. A free short phone consultation comes first, and packages of three sessions are also offered.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Meditation for Living Your Best Life (audio)
courses.description: A downloadable Amrit yoga nidra recording that moves slowly through the body with widening awareness, inviting the listener to let go of what holds them back.

courses.title: Chakra Balancing Alchemy Crystal Bowl Sound Bath (audio)
courses.description: A recorded sound bath in which she plays alchemy crystal singing bowls tuned to each of the chakras in turn, for listening at home.

courses.title: Cultivating Resilience: A Full Moon Guided Meditation and Alchemy Crystal Bowl Sound Bath (audio)
courses.description: A recording of a full moon gathering that pairs a guided meditation with a crystal bowl sound bath.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra Meditation for Divine Guidance
free_resources.description: A free Amrit yoga nidra recording that settles the body and opens the heart for prayerful listening to God.

free_resources.title: Divine Flow Prayer and Blessing
free_resources.description: A short free recording of a prayer and blessing she offers for living in the flow of the divine.
